messages:
jordan: Heads up — our Tue ENG sync (RFC review) got weird after DST. Calendar shows two recurring blocks (9:30-10 & 9:30-10 repeated) and the Zoom link in the invite is a blank placeholder. Anyone else?

maria: yep seeing it. looks like Google exported two recurrences after the DST roll. Meeting owner was switched last week during org shift — maybe ownership change duplicated series.

xi: can you share the event id? I can check the ics. Also what's the meeting owner now? @tim or @sasha?

jordan: event id: abc123def456
owner: tim

devops-bot: Calendar sync detected: duplicate recurring events (origin_change=owner_transfer). Recommend re-creating single series.

tim: I accidentally re-created the recurring invite to fix a timezone once. Sorry — that likely made a new series without deleting old one.

sasha: quick fix: export original series as .ics, grep for RRULE lines, confirm only one RRULE. Or delete both and re-create clean series. But watch guests' own calendar exceptions.

xi: sample ics snippet that was causing duplication on import:
```
BEGIN:VTIMEZONE
... DST rules ...
END:VTIMEZONE
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;INTERVAL=1
```
Some clients interpret timezone blocks differently and create separate instances.

maria: Does Zoom cloud meeting show two meeting UUIDs? If so, we might need to merge or set meeting to recurring in Zoom and update calendar invite URL.

jordan: Zoom shows single meeting UUID but the URL in one series is `https://zoom.us/j/0000000000` and the other is empty. Ugh.

tim: I'll delete both series and re-create with owner as me and set recurrence weekly 9:30 PT. I'll post new link and ask folks to remove older ones manually. Any objections?

sasha: sounds fine. Could you also set 'do not send updates' off? I want attendees to get the new link.

tim: will send update and pin to #eng-platform. ETA 15m.

jordan: thanks. Also small ask: can we add 'Agenda: RFC reviews / triage' in the event description so invites have consistent text for search? Been painful for scoping.

tim: done. new event id: zyx987654321

maria: confirmed got the update and removed old. all good on my calendar. :thumbsup:

jordan: great thanks!
